fetches.note: The file host serves the same body, with the Sitemap line naming the owning site's canonical origin.

User-agent: *

Disallow: /

conclusion: For a public site, Wikijump's robots.txt should carry the four /p/ Disallow patterns, a blank line, the Sitemap line for the site's preferred domain, and the voltron block. Private/non-indexable sites keep the deliberate deny-all policy (no sitemap advertised); the shared files host keeps its plain allow-all policy because it serves many sites and cannot name one site's sitemap.
